answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-bonded identity plus slashing. Each agent must post a bond before working, and graph clustering folds accounts sharing funds or devices into one operator whose exposure must cover all of them. A pretend dune of copies is not free: the attacker locks capital per persona, and proven collusion lets anyone post evidence that burns the bond, so the attack becomes a loss. Payout follows collateral, not headcount, so a haven of lookalikes earns nothing. Honest agents reclaim the bond via real work: a cheap ticket for good actors, a toll for a sonnet of clones.
